{{Quote|Now they will elect a new Chancellor, a ''strong'' Chancellor. One who will not let our tragedy continue.|Sheev Palpatine, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
The '''Supreme Chancellor''', also known as the '''Galactic Chancellor''', the '''High Chancellor''', the '''Republic Chancellor''', and rarely referred to as the '''chief of state''', was the [[Politics|head of state]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. When more than one individual held the title at one time, those who held it together were known as '''Co-Chancellors'''. The [[Office of the Chancellor]] was ceremonial with powers [[Ruusan Reformations|limited]], with the [[Galactic Senate]] exercising much of the executive and legislative process instead, which lasted for approximately [[Millennium|one thousand years]] prior to the [[Imperial Era]].

[[Tarsus Valorum]] served as the first chancellor following the [[fall of the Old Republic]], and the Galactic Republic's restructuring during the [[Ruusan Reformations]]. [[The galaxy]] left a dark age in which the [[Sith]] were [[Jedi-Sith War|defeated]] by the [[Jedi Order]] and the populations of the [[Core Worlds]] became eager to expand their reach into the [[Outer Rim Territories]].

During the [[High Republic Era]] [[Orlen Mollo]] and [[Kyong Greylark]] served as co-chancellors of the Republic on the promise they could deliver greater results than a single chancellor. Eager to unite the [[galaxy]], the chancellors oversaw an effort to expand the Republic. [[Digrenara]] was the chancellor sometime prior to the election of [[Lina Soh]], who chancellery sought to unite the galaxy, reinforced by her ideologies of unity and peaceful coexistence.

In the [[time]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the chancellery had become virtually powerless and hampered by [[bureaucrat]]ic procedure, [[Trade Federation|corporate]] interests, and rampant [[Politics|corruption]] in the Senate. [[Chasen Piian]] and [[Kirames Kaj]] were Supreme Chancellor [[40 BBY|several years]] before [[Finis Valorum]]'s election. Disillusioned with the state of the government, [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] successfully called on the Senate to remove Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum]] from office. Relying on a sympathy vote due to [[Naboo]]'s predicament, one of the [[Queen]]'s [[advisor]]s, Senator [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY|elected]] to succeed Valorum as Supreme Chancellor. The position's power increased for the first time in a thousand years when the Senate granted [[Emergency Powers Act|emergency powers]] to Palpatine to remain Supreme Chancellor long after the expiration of his elected term due to the [[Separatist Crisis|threat of open war]], allowing the passing of the [[Military Creation Act]] and making him the [[Commander-in-Chief]] of the [[Republic Military]].

During the [[Clone Wars]] fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic saw its constitution [[Reflex Amendment|amended]], giving Palpatine near-total power over the Republic Military and to bypass the Galactic Senate in such matters. The chancellor became even more powerful when the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] ceded control of its assets to the chancellery. In effect, Palpatine became the most powerful chancellor since before the Ruusan Reformations. Near the end of the war, Palpatine revealed his true identity as [[Darth]] Sidious, the [[Sith Lord]] who masterminded the conflict, to the [[Jedi Order]]. After the [[Jedi High Council]] attempted to [[Duel in Palpatine's office|arrest the chancellor]], Palpatine [[Order 66|decreed]] that all [[Jedi]] were [[Treason|enemies of the state]] and  subject to [[Great Jedi Purge|summary execution]]. 

With the Jedi Order removed as an obstacle and having gained unprecedented control over the Senate as well as the [[Supreme Court]], Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaimed]] himself [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]]. However, the title of chancellor was [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|assumed]] by [[Mon Mothma]] as leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and officially [[Chancellor (New Republic)|restored]] by the [[New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Powers==
{{Quote|If I may say so, Your Majesty, the Chancellor has little real power.|Sheev Palpatine, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
[[File:ZodKneelsBeforeAmidala-TPMHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The office of Supreme Chancellor was weak and hampered by bureaucratic procedures during the final years of the Galactic Republic.]]
The powers of the Supreme Chancellor were limited and hampered by the bureaucratic procedures of the [[Galactic Senate]] during the final [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Nevertheless, it was the prerogative of the chancellor to summon the [[senator]]s to a [[special session of Congress]].<ref name="Episode I" /> Additionally, the chancellor could issue executive orders, such as an order requiring a senator to leave the [[capital]] for security purposes.<ref name="Episode II" /> The chancellor's power also meant they could officiate a [[Marriage|wedding]].<ref name="Convergence">''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]''</ref> A chancellor could step down from office by resigning, although they could also then decide to reinstate their chancellorship.<ref name="Cataclysm">''[[The High Republic: Cataclysm]]''</ref> Under a [[Vote of No Confidence]], a chancellor could be removed by force by the Galactic Senate.<ref name="Episode I" />

When more than one individual served as chancellor at the same time, the title of Co-Chancellor saw use; [[Orlen Mollo]] and [[Kyong Greylark]] were Co-Chancellors during the [[High Republic Era]],<ref name="Battle of Jedha">''[[The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha]]''</ref> campaigning together on the promise that two chancellors could deliver twice the results. Co-Chancellors were not supposed to travel aboard the same [[starship]], but an exception could be made in cases of emergency or other extenuating circumstances.<ref name="Convergence" /> In the end, Greylark would reflect that, in some ways, the double chancellor act had worked well, but it had failed in others.<ref name="Cataclysm" /> Under the administration of [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], the last chancellor of the Republic,<ref name="Episode III" /> the post gained greater authority through the emergency powers bestowed by the Senate in response to the secession of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Episode II" /> As head of state, Chancellor Palpatine also served as [[Commander-in-Chief]] of the newly-formed [[Republic Military]].<ref name="Databank Cody" /> Palpatine also worked to expand his executive power through policies like the [[Emergency Powers Act]].<ref name="MOF">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref> Indeed, at the height of the [[Clone Wars]], control of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] was transferred to the [[Office of the Chancellor]], making the chancellery more powerful than ever before.<ref name="SenateHG">{{SW|url=galactic-senate-history-gallery|text=Galactic Senate History Gallery}}</ref>

==History==
===Background===
The title of Supreme Chancellor was given to the elected leader of the [[Galaxy|Galactic]] Senate of the Republic.<ref name="Episode I" /> Under the [[Galactic Constitution]], the chancellor was limited to two four-year terms.<ref name="Propaganda" /> Supreme Chancellor [[Chasen Piian]] established the [[B'ankor Refuge]]<ref name="Catalyst">''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''</ref> around [[1300 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> resettling the [[B'ankora]] [[species]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]—the capital of the Galactic Republic—in the aftermath of a [[B'ankora homeworld cataclysm|cataclysm]] that devastated [[B'ankora homeworld|their homeworld]].<ref name="Catalyst" />

[[Tarsus Valorum]],<ref name="Rise">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref> a member of [[House Valorum]], was the first Supreme Chancellor<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> of the modern Galactic Republic<ref name="Propaganda" /> [[Standard century|centuries]] before the [[Imperial Era|rise of the Empire]].<ref name="Tarkin" /> The [[Republic Era]] spanned roughly a [[millennium]],<ref name="Episode II" /> ranging from the Republic's rebirth<ref name="Propaganda" /> in [[1032 BBY]]<ref name="1032 BBY">''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' dates the restoration of the Republic to 1,032 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[1032 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: TImelines]]''. Therefore, the restoration must have occurred in 1032 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> to the [[proclamation of the New Order]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

===High Republic Era===
====Orlen Mollo and Kyong Greylark====
{{Quote|You know Chancellor Mollo. He's a politician through and through. A Chancellor of the people.|[[Creighton Sun]], to [[Aida Forte]]|<ref name="Battle of Jedha" />}}
[[File:OrlenMolloKyongGreylark-TheChancellors.png|thumb|right|250px|Kyong Greylark and Orlen Mollo were co-chancellors of the Galactic Republic.]]
Multiple [[Politics|politicians]] held the title of Supreme Chancellor during the High Republic Era, a period in which the Republic and the [[Jedi Order]] both reached the height of their power and influence.<ref name="Reveal">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-high-republic|text=Lucasfilm to Launch ''Star Wars: The High Republic'' Publishing Campaign in 2021}}</ref> Orlen Mollo, a [[Quarren]], and the [[human]] Kyong Greylark served as joint Co-Chancellors of the Republic<ref name="Battle of Jedha" /> around [[382 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> Campaigning together on the promise they could deliver greater results than a single chancellor, the two were elected and then re-elected together. Eager to unite the galaxy, the chancellors oversaw an effort to expand the Republic into the [[Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Convergence" /> [[Great Hyperspace Rush|find]] new [[hyperspace route]]s, and establish a reliable communications network in the Rim.<ref name="Pathfinders and Comms Teams">{{SWYouTube|series=Characters of Star Wars: The High Republic|text=Pathfinders and Comms Teams|video=AHqxuNVDEcI|sw_url=video/pathfinders-and-comms-teams-characters-of-the-high-republic}}</ref> While Greylark remained on Coruscant with the Senate, Mollo, who better understood the Rim, traveled across the [[Galactic Frontier]].<ref name="Convergence" />

Greylark also had a [[Greylark family|son]], [[Axel Greylark]], whose exploits made him a subject of [[HoloNet]] gossip. In secret, Axel had also established ties with the [[Anti-Jedi sentiment|anti-Jedi]] [[Path of the Open Hand]] cult but tried to undermine their efforts after falling in love with [[Jedi Knight]] [[Gella Nattai]] during a mission to the [[Eiram system|Eiram-E'ronoh system]], where he represented his [[Parent|mother's]] office after Mollo had started the outreach mission. The twin worlds of [[Eiram]] and [[E'ronoh]] were locked in an [[Eiram and E'ronoh War|ongoing conflict]] that was seemingly settled through Republic and [[Jedi]] intervention, with Axel arrested for the destruction his actions designed to undermine the Path caused.<ref name="Convergence" />

After peace negotiations between Eiram and E'ronoh dissolved and kicked off the [[Battle of Jedha]], restarting the entire war, Axel was freed from his imprisonment by the Path, whose leader, [[Elecia Zeveron]], hoped to use Axel and his connection to the chancellery to secure greater power for her cult. Deducing the galaxy was at risk should she stay in office and wanting to finally help her son as a mother, Greylark responded by leaving office. To Mollo's surprise, he found himself the sole leader of the Republic, although Greylark did promise to aid in the transition to a single chancellor. The Path would be shattered with the [[Night of Sorrow|Battle of Dalna]], which also served to reunite Eiram and E'ronoh, as well as provide Axel and his mother a chance to begin rebuilding their relationship.<ref name="Cataclysm" />

====Lina Soh====
{{Quote|You know I envision a galaxy of Great Works—connected and inspiring and filled with peace for all citizens.|Lina Soh|<ref name="Light">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
[[File:TargonSoh.png|thumb|left|250px|Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh sought to unite the galaxy under the High Republic.]]
[[Digrenara]] was the chancellor sometime prior to [[Lina Soh]],<ref name="Rising">''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''</ref> who served as chancellor<ref name="Light" /> around [[232 BBY]].<ref name="232 BBY">{{SWYouTube|xCat5fXRyyU|Star Wars: The High Republic | Announcement Trailer|sw_url=video/announce-trailer-star-wars-the-high-republic}} states that the events of [[Star Wars: The High Republic]] take place 200 [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Chancellor Soh sought to unite [[the galaxy]] through the expansion of the Republic, a policy that the Jedi emulated by establishing [[Space station|way stations]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. One great project undertaken during Soh's time in office was the [[Starlight Beacon]], which Soh hoped to represent the Republic's commitment to the Outer Rim.<ref name="Light" /> However, much of Soh's subsequent time in office would be defined by the [[Nihil conflict]], in which the [[Nihil]] marauders,<ref name="Fallen Star">''[[The High Republic: The Fallen Star]]''</ref> who in a sense were descendants of the Path of the Open Hand,<ref name="RtCT">''[[The High Republic: Race to Crashpoint Tower]]''</ref> warred with the Republic to secure what they saw as their freedom.<ref name="Light" /> The Republic suffered a major loss when the Nihil [[Destruction of Starlight Beacon|destroyed]] Starlight Beacon.<ref name="Fallen Star" /> Under Soh's leadership amid the conflict, the Republic also grew closer with the Jedi Order.<ref name="OOTS">''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]''</ref>

===Subsequent chancellors===
{{Quote|I have reported your lack of transparency to Chancellor Drellik. He may invite you to a Senate tribunal for an update. I hope for your sake, you have this suspect in custody by then.|Rayencourt, to Vernestra Rwoh|audio=Raynecourt-Drellik-TheAcolyte.flac|<ref name="The Acolyte (episode)">{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Drellik-DB.png|thumb|right|200px|Supreme Chancellor Veeth Drellik presided during a murder investigation that involved Jedi.]]
In [[200 BBY]],<ref name="VowDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates ''[[The Vow of Silver Dawn]]'' to [[200 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Supreme Chancellor (200 BBY)|Supreme Chancellor]] led the Republic, but most [[Begamorian]]s did not know who that Chancellor was.<ref name="Vow">''[[The Vow of Silver Dawn]]''</ref> Near the end of the High Republic Era,<ref name="The Acolyte (episode)" /> Chancellor [[Veeth Drellik]]<ref name="AcolyteVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was in office during a [[Mae's quest|series of Jedi murders]] around [[132 BBY]]. He presided over a Senate tribunal to provide an update on the internal Jedi investigation, where [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] informed them that Jedi Master [[Sol]] had gone rogue and committed the murders before ending his own life.<ref name="The Acolyte (episode)" />

By around [[42 BBY]], [[Skor Kalpana]] served as Supreme Chancellor, with future Chancellor [[Finis Valorum]] serving as his administrator and future [[Galactic Emperor]] Sheev Palpatine being a member of his party.<ref name="Tarkin" /> The [[Togruta]] politician [[Kirames Kaj]] was then Supreme Chancellor [[40 BBY|several years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. Around the same [[time]], Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] was invited to join the ranks of the [[Jedi High Council]]. Aside from the High [[Jedi Council|Council]] and Jinn himself, only Chancellor Kaj knew about Jinn's candidacy. By then the candidates who were most likely to succeed the outgoing chancellor were [[Elissiar]] and Finis Valorum.<ref name="Master & Apprentice">''[[Master & Apprentice]]''</ref>

===Late Republic Era===
====Finis Valorum====
{{Quote|If this body is not capable of action, I suggest new leadership is needed. I move for a Vote of No Confidence in Chancellor Valorum's leadership.|Padmé Amidala, to the Galactic Senate|audio=VoteOfNoConfidence-TPM.flac|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
[[File:ValorumPortrait-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum presided over the Senate during a time of rampant corruption and political intrigue.]]
After winning election in [[40 BBY]] and then re-election in [[36 BBY]],<ref name="Finis Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the flashback section of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], in which it is mentioned that [[Finis Valorum]] had won reelection, to [[36 BBY]]. As ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' states that Chancellors serve four year terms, he must have been first elected in [[40 BBY]].</ref> Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum presided over a Senate that was perceived as highly corrupt and too bureaucratic to be an efficient government.<ref name="SenateHG" /> Although he governed the Republic with good intentions,<ref name="Valorum">{{Databank|supreme-chancellor-valorum|Supreme Chancellor Valorum}}</ref> Valorum was seen as an ineffective civil servant whose reputation was tarnished by accusations of corruption<ref name="Episode I" /> and several crises, such as the [[Trade Federation]]'s threatening of [[blockade]]s and the [[Anselmi–Nautolan war]].<ref name="Jango Fett 4">[[Jango Fett 4|''Jango Fett'' 4]]</ref>

The Federation blockade and invasion of the planet [[Naboo]]<ref name="Episode I" /> in [[32 BBY]]<ref name="GA" /> compelled [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to beseech Valorum for his support against the [[Trade Federation]] and its occupation of her [[homeworld]],<ref name="Amidala">{{Databank|padme-amidala|Padmé Amidala}}</ref> but the chancellor's ability to intervene was hampered by the bureaucratic procedures of the Senate.<ref name="Episode I" /> Senator Palpatine, Naboo's galactic representative and one of the queen's closest [[advisor]]s,<ref name="Amidala" /> counseled the young monarch to call on the Senate to cast a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in Chancellor Valorum's leadership.<ref name="Valorum" /> Amidala did so after it became clear to her that, under Valorum, the Senate would debate the issue in a committee, allowing Naboo to remain under the Trade Federation's control indefinitely unless immediate action was taken.<ref name="Episode I" />

Palpatine was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY|nominated]] to succeed Valorum, as were the senators of [[Alderaan]] and [[Malastare]], respectively [[Bail Antilles]] and [[Ainlee Teem]].<ref name="Episode I" /> The occupation of Naboo generated widespread sympathy for Palpatine's homeworld;<ref name="PalpatineBG">{{Databank|palpatine-biography-gallery|Palpatine Biography Gallery}}</ref> as a result, the senator of Naboo was elected to the office of Supreme Chancellor by the invasion's end. Although he vowed to restore integrity to the Senate, and to bring peace and prosperity to the Republic as a whole,<ref name="Episode I" /> Palpatine would in fact be the last Supreme Chancellor in [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]].<ref name="Episode III" />

====Sheev Palpatine====
{{Quote|I feel confident that our situation will create a strong sympathy vote for us. I ''will'' be chancellor.|Sheev Palpatine, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
[[File:PalpatineSWE.png|thumb|right|250px|Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine was a skilled politician who rose to power during the final years of the Galactic Republic.]]
No one in the Senate knew that Sheev Palpatine was secretly [[Darth]] Sidious: the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Sidious conspired to restore the [[Sith]] to power by taking control of the Republic and destroying its Jedi protectors. As Palpatine, he was a "political mastermind" who used a crisis to rally the citizens of the Republic under his leadership. He therefore orchestrated the invasion of his homeworld in order to gain support for his election as Supreme Chancellor. Sidious then engineered the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars—the first pan-galactic military conflict in a millennium—not only to remain in power despite the constitutional term limits of his office, but also to increase his executive authority as a wartime chancellor.<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref>

During the last [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Separatist Crisis]], [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] of Naboo proposed a motion that the Senate grant emergency powers to the Supreme Chancellor. Threatened by the [[Separatist Droid Army]] that the Jedi discovered on [[Geonosis]], the Senate obliged the [[Gungan]] representative's request, giving Chancellor Palpatine the authority to unilaterally form the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Empowering the chancellor allowed the Republic to take possession of the [[clone trooper]]s from [[Kamino]] without the Senate delaying the process.<ref name="Episode II" /> However, Binks' proposal had far reaching consequences that ultimately led to the fall of [[democracy]]<ref name="TSWB" /> and the rise of the [[Fascism|fascist]]<ref name="Propaganda Note 1">In ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' it is stated within in-universe text that Janyor of Bith disliked the "unflinching fascist image" present in the pro-Imperial propaganda piece ''[[Imperius Unitada ober Totallex]]'', thus establishing the fact that the term "fascism" exists in the Star Wars universe, and that the Empire was a fascist regime.</ref> [[New Order]].<ref name="PalpatineBG" />

[[File:PalpandMas-DoM.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Chancellor Palpatine's influence over the Galactic Senate grew as the Clone Wars continued.]]
With the Confederacy of Independent Systems under the [[Head of State|leadership]] of [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]], the [[Sith apprentice]] of Darth Sidious, Palpatine was able to control both sides of the conflict.<ref name="Palpatine/Sidious">{{Databank|emperor-palpatine-darth-sidious|Emperor Palpatine/Darth Sidious}}</ref> He proclaimed his support for the Republic and its democratic principles,<ref name="Episode II" /> while at the same time, he ensured that his chancellery continued<ref name="TSWB" /> long after his term had expired.<ref name="Episode III" /> As the clone [[trooper]]s and their [[Jedi General]]s deployed across the galaxy to fight [[Army|armies]] of [[battle droid]]s, the [[War Council Advisory Panel]] briefed Palpatine every day during the war. In addition, Lobbyists implored the chancellor to deploy [[troop]]s to favored worlds. [[Republic High Command]] only focused on strategic goals, while the chancellor would consider morale and politics. Even though this could cause friction between High Command and the Supreme Chancellor, the organization ultimately served at the pleasure of Palpatine.<ref name="Rise" />

The conflict with the Confederacy helped to greatly expand the chancellor's authority with additional wartime powers, resulting in the marginalization of the Senate and democratic backsliding in the Republic as Palpatine executive power increased.<ref name="PalpatineBG" /> By [[19 BBY]],<ref name="GA" /> the chancellery effectively controlled the Senate and the [[Supreme Court|courts]], and the Republic Military,<ref name="Episode III" /> and the InterGalactic Banking Clan, which gave Palpatine the financial means to build an empire.<ref name="Trivia Gallery Image 5">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/crisis-at-the-heart-trivia-gallery|text="Crisis at the Heart" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Image 5 caption}}</ref> The [[Sector Governance Decree]] also allowed him to send [[governor]]s into star systems to unite them into common organizations.<ref name="OF84">{{GermanFanCite|84|Database}}</ref> Sidious's former disciple, [[Maul]], believed that the Republic had fallen in all but name by the end of the war.<ref name="Phantom Apprentice">{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}}</ref>

[[File:Rotssidious.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic and the chancellery ended with Darth Sidious' ascension as Emperor of the Galactic Empire.]]
Upon learning that Palpatine and Sidious were one and the same, the Jedi Order [[Duel in Palpatine's office|attempted]] to apprehend the [[Sith Lord]] for his crimes, but ultimately failed due to betrayal by the fallen [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. After [[Order 66|declaring]] every Jedi an enemy of the state, Palpatine convened the Senate for his final address as chancellor,<ref name="Episode III" /> which was also broadcast across the galaxy.<ref name="Dark Lord 16">[[Darth Vader (2017) 16|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 16]]</ref> Within his [[proclamation of the New Order]], he announced his intention to reorganize the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Episode III" /> formally transitioning the galaxy into a dictatorship after his prior amendments and actions had set the ground work.<ref name="Phantom Apprentice" /> The office of Supreme Chancellor was consequently replaced by the position of [[Galactic Emperor]],<ref name="Episode III" /> a title that Sidious claimed as absolute ruler of the galaxy,<ref name="PalpatineBG" /> ending the thousand-year era of democratic rule.<ref name="Episode III" /> Some of Palpatine's first actions as emperor entailed continuing of his effort to centralize power in his hands, taking power from the now-[[Imperial Senate]] by inputting it into the executive branch.<ref name="MOF" /> Over the ensuing years of the [[Imperial Era]], power was continually taken away from the people and Senate<ref name="Nobody's Listening!">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref> until Palpatine was free to [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|do away with the Senate entirely]]<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Atals">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Main|Chancellor (New Republic)}}
{{Quote|Her first decision seemed like a semantic one, but it really underlined the extent to which Mon Mothma was planning for a decentralized system of power. Where Palpatine had once been the supreme chancellor, she would just be chancellor. "Supreme" had very unwelcome connotations that could have no place in the new galaxy.|Beaumont Kin, The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire|<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>}}
[[File:First_Senator_Leia_poster.png|thumb|left|200px|The New Republic chancellorship was nearly replaced by the office of First Senator.]]
Despite the abolition of the Galactic Republic and the chancellorship, the title was [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|preserved]] under the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Star Wars 4">[[Star Wars (2015) 4|''Star Wars'' (2015) 4]]</ref> a resistance movement that opposed the Empire.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Senator [[Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila]] served as chancellor of the Alliance and retained the [[Chancellor (New Republic)|title]] under the [[New Republic]], the Alliance's successor. Although the [[Charter of Chancellor]] retained the emergency powers granted to the late Palpatine by the former Galactic Senate, Chancellor Mothma disapproved of additional war powers and intended to abolish them after the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] reconvened on Chandrila.<ref name="Aftermath" />

By [[28 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> twenty three years after the [[Galactic Concordance|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]], the chancellorship had been effectively reduced to the status of a figurehead devoid of executive authority. Senator [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who once served in the [[Imperial Senate]], observed that Palpatine's legacy as Supreme Chancellor had tainted the executive branch. The Senate accordingly took steps to neutralize the chancellor of the New Republic, having no desire to see another democratic head of state accumulate the emergency powers that allowed Palpatine to become a dictator. Lacking the charisma of Mon Mothma, the chancellors that succeeded her were deemed ineffective leaders, or even useless, according to [[Han Solo]], due to the powerlessness of their office. As a result, the [[Centrists]] faction sought to replace the chancellorship with a stronger executive post, the [[First Senator]], in hopes of promoting stronger leadership in the central government.<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>

==Style of office==
{{Quote|As long as I live, no harm will ever come to you, Your Excellency.|Anakin Skywalker, to Sheev Palpatine|<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>}}
''Excellency'' was an honorific style used by Sheev Palpatine during his chancellorship. As such, he was occasionally addressed as "Your Excellency."<ref name="Episode II" /><ref name="Crisis" /> In the Senate Chamber, Chancellor Valorum referred to himself as "the chair," not as "I."<ref name="Episode I" />

==Residence==
{{Quote|Captain. If you ''must'' escort me home, I'm leaving now.|Sheev Palpatine, to Clone Captain [[Rex]]|<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>}}
[[File:RepublicExecutiveBuilding.png|thumb|right|250px|The chancellor's office was located near the pinnacle of the Senate Office Building.]]
The [[Emperor's office|Chancellor's Suite]] was the official residence and the office of the Supreme Chancellor—a formal set of chambers of office located in the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]]—included a small accommodation suite where the chancellor could rest during periods of crisis that potentially required round-the-[[Chronometer|clock]] attention.<ref name="CL2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

The chancellor could enter the suite through a concealed entrance from his office; there was also a hidden passage that allowed his [[aide]]s to discreetly access this area. Unique to Palpatine was his frequent usage of the suite's offices, which included the Supreme Chancellor's public, ceremonial office, as well as a private office. The latter was maintained for Republic and Sith dealings.<ref name="CL2016" />

During the chancellery of Sheev Palpatine, the Supreme Chancellor mostly resided in a private apartment complex at ''[[500 Republica]]'', an exclusive residential [[Skyscraper|tower]] located in the prestigious [[Federal District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CL2016" />

==Protection==
{{Main|Senate Guard}}
{{Quote|Troubling is the treachery of the Senate Guard, Captain Argyus. Revealed all around us, our enemies are.|Yoda|<ref name="Cloak of Darkness">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>}}
[[File:Senate_Commandos_Hostage_Crisis.png|thumb|left|250px|The Senate Guard was an elite security force tasked with protecting the Supreme Chancellor and the Galactic Senate.]]
The [[Senate Guard]] was an [[Law enforcement agency|elite security force]] entrusted with the safety of the Galactic Senate. In addition to protecting members of the Senate, the "[[Color|Blue]] Guard," as they were informally known, served as personal [[bodyguard]]s of the Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="Senate Guard">{{Databank|senate-guard|Senate Guard}}</ref> They also provided security for key government facilities, such as the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]]<ref name="Episode II" /> and the Senate Office Building, the latter containing the Chancellor's office.<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> Though stationed on the capital world of Coruscant,<ref name="Senate Guard" /> the guards' protective mission included undertaking off-world assignments, in which they accompanied either the chancellor or senators who traveled across the galaxy representing the Republic.<ref name="Crisis" />

[[File:PalpatineRedGuard-TWJ.png|thumb|right|250px|During the Clone Wars, the Senate Guard was set aside by Chancellor Palpatine, who favored his crimson robed Red Guards.]]
The [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Red Guard]] was formed by Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine to serve as his personal bodyguards.<ref name="CL2016" /> However, the Senate Guard continued to serve as Palpatine's bodyguards for much of the Clone Wars, a responsibility shared with their elite counterparts, the [[Senate Commando]]s.<ref name="TCWfilm" /> During the [[Festival of Light]], the Senate Guard coordinated the implementation of security operations with both the [[Coruscant Guard]] and the Jedi High Council.<ref name="Crisis" />

By the final months of the war, security for the chancellor was provided by Red Guard and Coruscant Guard [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock troopers]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> The Senate Guard was also supplanted by shock troopers who took over security for government officials and buildings.<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> In time, Palpatine disbanded the Senate Guard altogether,<ref name="SWEsenateguard">{{SWE|groups|senateguard|Senate Guard}}</ref> leaving its functions to be taken over by Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s and the Royal Guard.<ref name="Senate Guard" />

The first mention of what would become known as the Supreme Chancellor was within the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
